reasoning_traces.think:
The system's runtime architecture is defined by three core components: persistent task handling, gated workflow execution, and queue abstraction. Task persistence ensures continuity through memory fallbacks, while workflow gates enforce conditional execution paths. Queue facades abstract infrastructure dependencies, enabling safe operation even when Redis is unavailable. These primitives form a layered kernel where each component supports the next—tasks depend on workflows, which depend on queues. The failure mode occurs when Redis is absent, disabling BullMQ workers but not core runtime functions. This design reflects a modular, resilient system that maintains operational integrity under partial infrastructure loss.
